items: First Administrative Reforms Commission (1966) recommended the setup of Lokpal.
Lokpal bill faced multiple failures in Parliament before finally being passed in 2013.
Core rationale tested: Enacted for transparency and accountability in governance.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Lokpal was recommended by the First Administrative Reforms Commission in 1966.
Multiple Lokpal bills failed in Parliament prior to the 2013 passage.
Public anti-corruption movements provided crucial momentum for the passage of the bill.
The legislation was enacted specifically to promote transparency and accountability.
